title: メディア情報専門実験・演習Ａ
subtitle: Media Informatics Major Lab/Exercises A
educationalGoal:
This course is based on two themes, Modeling and Fabrication, and Video Prodoction.
In Fabrication and Modeling, students will be given opportunities to design and output 3DCG data to a real 3D object by using a 3D printer.
In video production, students will learn the production process of video work and  the expertise of shooting and editing.
advice:
Fabrication and Modeling:
Students experience prototyping by designing, modeling and outputting  objects that they will use personally.
Students learn digital manufacturing for personal use by outputting their individually created designs to 3D printer, paper and AR.

Video Prodcution:
Students learn and practice the expertise of shooting and editing.
Students experience a series of the video production process through making original movie by shooting and editing based on storyboard.
requiredKnowledge:
Students must pay sufficient attention to safety during experiments.
Students must perform their fabrication experiments carefully and according to given instructions.

activityGoals.body: Be able to create 3DCG digital data suitable for fabrication use and output the data as actual 3D objects.
Be able to conceive and produce appropriate designs.
Be able to make presentations regarding student efforts.
Be able to explain video production process
Be able to prepare progress schedule and storyboard
Be able to create movie using non-linear editing software
